title: Go To Market Sales Playbook
content: Step 1: Identify Ideal Customer Profile - ICP - Determine the right ICP. We will need 10-20 customers listed on Ohm to develop a profile. - We can us platforms such as Mindbody and Classpass to identify suitable gyms and studios who could have interest in listing in ohmgym.com Step 2: Define our Buyer's Journey. - What are their challenges? - Higher marketing and transaction fees on platforms such a as MindBody.

title: Go To Market Sales Playbook
content: - Constant promotions to fill classes - Why do they need the product now? - Lower entrance fees - A future with a all inclusive platform to manage: - Website - Bookings - Transaction system - Marketing platform - Flexible pricing - What else are they considering? - How are they going to make the decision? - Are they able to fill classes and remain profitable? - Does more web traffic come to their page? - **" If you could push your prices below $30 per class because fees to the platform you are using are lower, would you choose that platform to bring more bookings to your classes and studio?"** - What's a must-have and nice to have? - What is their timing? - What is their definition of Success? - What is their goal? - To make money - Fill classes up - The find new people to book classes. Expand clientele and retain attendees - To create a convenient way to search for workouts in local areas by the searcher (gym attendee) - Align on what success means to them and deliver it.

title: Go To Market Sales Playbook
content: Step 3: Develop Guides to Support the Buyer's journey

title: Branding, Marketing, & Investors
content: - *Branding** - We are looking to build a inclusive brand that makes the barrier to entry easy for people looking to book workouts. - No memberships, subscriptions, or credit systems. - 1 time payments. - Convenience on the go. - No fees for Consumers. - Tip your Hosts to show signs of appreciation. Help cover cleaning costs to smaller gym owners and home gym owners - A more equitable platform for gym owners, taking large cut than our competitors. Ohm is beginning with a competive rate for gym - Flexible pricing for gym owners. Complete control over your off-peak hour pricing. - In all inclusive webpage, booking, online marketing, and payment system for gym owners. - Vision Statement - Accessible Fitness for All. - Discover your Fitness Sanctuary - Whenever you are on the go, Discovery your Fitness Sanctuary. - Changing the way the fitness industry does commerce.

title: Branding, Marketing, & Investors
content: - Lending Clubs Vision Statement - To make credit more affordable and investing more rewarding - How can we model this marketplace message to display the two sides of the the gym owner/gym goer dynamic. - Find your fitness haven. - *Marketing** - Tennis and Pickleball Courts - People pay already by the hour and for multiple hours - We can offer a better rates by charging no fees to consumers and a more fair rate cut for court managers or hosts - We also want to build a community of fitness sanctuary's so we plan to support our community by pushing local ads on google ads and social media - Market Share Penetration - No fees for bookings. - People will feel more welcomed - More cost competitive for consumers - People favor no fees so more fitness places, home gyms, and studios will want to list with OhmGym. - Flexible pricing for different hours of the day. Off-peak hours can be difficult to fill.

title: Branding, Marketing, & Investors
content: - *Investors ** - We plan to operate at a low profit margin to gain more listings and bookings. - Attractive rate rate of only 10% and no fees for guests. - The payment fee is part of the 10% cut. - Limiting booking software available with MVP but can scale a free offering of a CRM to attract more fitness places to list. - We want to determine the cost of operation for free to minimal payment for full business management software to bring in more small business looking for higher margins. - We seek investments to build mobile apps and remove our web framework which takes $0.19 per transaction. - We know that the Silicon Valley method of taking a loss per transaction to boost sign ups and revenue for growth isn't a viable option in todays market. Our low profit margin for each transaction is our way of attracting consumers to our platform while being attractive to investors. - We plan to operate as a very lean startup so that the cost of operations remains lower.

title: Branding, Marketing, & Investors
content: Each role will be carefully evaluated if it is needed. - We believe building a business from scratch in a tough business environment will give us skills and perseverance so when the market shifts to a easier business environment, we are better equipped to succeed.

title: Future Ideas of OhmGym
content: - Filter features for price limits or ceilings for certain workouts like Yoga. - Why - Ability to quickly search for available Yoga studios in local neighborhood that fit the guests budget. - Current search flow > Google it > check out the sponsor > look at yelp > shop around what fits your needs and budget - With Ohm - Quick search by workout and location > Filter by budget and reviews. - Full suite of calendar booking software for small gym owners, available at no extra charge. - Easy way for groups to book workouts and split the transaction evenly. - Tips - Can guests provide tips to complimentary trainers and home gym owners for to cover cleaning fees. - For intro promos set by gym owners, we don't take fee. - Will need to set a criteria to avoid any money loss. Breaking even is the goal with these promos. - The system is intelligent enough to know who is new to a gyms and gyms in area, or new area. -

title: Angel Investor Pitch Notes
content:
We believe we can deliver value by unlocking underutilized assists (unused
home gyms built during the pandemic) and using technology to increase that
utilization rate. Along with this value is the ability to foster community by allowing small gym
owners to platform their workout facility with their own webpage, calendar,
online marketing, and payment infrastructure, all in one place. - We've demonstrated this by supporting our local small gym owners by running online marketing ads for them. - *PRODUCT MARKET FIT** - - Global home fitness equipment market was valued at $11.15 billion in 2022 and projected to rise to $16.56 billion in 2030, a compound annual growth rate of 4.9%. As for the US, the home equipment market value is $4.81 billion in 2022 and projected to grow to $8.5 billion by 2030, and compound annual growth rate of 7.59%.

title: Angel Investor Pitch Notes
content:
We plan to work with our communities by having listing and using search engine
optimization and social media ads to direct people to their listings as well
as OhmGym. We offer no fees to consumers. We believe that to achieve our mission of
accessible fitness for all and to be in their fitness sanctuary where every
they are, no fee for customers that book. This makes an attractive offer to
move people to book on our platform in the early days. As for Hosts such as Home Gym, Yoga Studios, and Courts of all variations. The problem we are tying to solve is to make fitness facilities more
accessible for all. People who love to go to the gym pay a membership for a
month but run into problems when they travel or need a private workout during
peak hours. Hosts pay 1 time fees for using a CRM software, plus transactions fees for
both Hosts and Guests. Ohm Gym completely remove fees for customers and reduced fees for Hosts. Guests can tip Hosts to cover cleaning fees.

title: Angel Investor Pitch Notes
content:
Hosts do have to have General
Liability Insurance which comes out of pockets. Those range from $120 to $170
per month for small and independent gyms. Higher costs for larger gyms. Just
10-15 bookings per month can offset those costs. High Scale, High Volume. Unlocking more revenue will lead to better margins.
No fees for consumers will make us more cost competitive. Hosts will want to
use our platform because of lower fees on their end. No charge to use a CRM,
just the 10% cost. Our early Hosts are rate locked. Over time, we can decrease our technical over head expenses by removing
Sharetribe shortly and Stripe far down the line. Removing Sharetribe will require an investment of between $50,000 to $250,000
depending on how well we want the website and app to response across web, ios,
and adroid apps. Removing Stripe will require a multi million dollar investment.
